class.name: GameInvites
class.brief_description: The invite gateway for one game attachment.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Return whether this exact attachment has a ready invite backend.

method.name: open_overlay
method.description: Request the current hosted Steam lobby's invite picker. [constant OK] means Steam accepted the request, and [constant ERR_BUSY] means the overlay is loading.

method.name: send
method.description: Submit one invite to the selected decimal SteamID64 from the current owned lobby. [constant OK] means the request was submitted to Steam.

method.name: pending
method.description: Return the latest invite in this attachment, including one captured from Steam Apps launch arguments or the ordinary lobby command line. Crimson ignores malformed or conflicting lobby candidates. The game decides when to join.

signal.name: received
signal.description: Emitted for a Steam request to join while this game attachment is active, including Steam URL launches with a supported lobby argument. Duplicate notifications for the same lobby within two seconds are coalesced.
